g.title: One paired visit across all seven QCSD selections
g.desc: A planned workload visit expands into seven independent direct-capture samples. Every sample has the same PCAP, trace, and fidelity contract. The assignment is owned by a source-manifest-and-repetition split group, so aliases and other derivatives cannot leak across partitions. A failed, drifting, or fidelity-ineligible sample excludes the paired visit from headline comparison while remaining in operational statistics.
